faq.sub: What restaurateurs ask about table reservations in IQ Rest. If your question isn't listed — message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I choose the days and times when booking is available?
items.a: Yes. The admin panel lets you set a schedule per day of the week: booking hours and a break between lunch and dinner. You can also temporarily switch reservations off entirely — guests will see that online booking is unavailable.

items.q: Can I upload a photo of each table?
items.a: Yes. Every table has a photo, a capacity and a zone (terrace, by the window, bar). Guests see exactly which table they're reserving and make an informed choice.

items.q: Can I limit the number of guests per table?
items.a: Yes. Every table has a set capacity — the system offers guests only suitable tables and blocks a two-seater from being booked by a party of six.

items.q: How hard is it to set up reservations?
items.a: Three steps: add tables with photos and capacity, enable booking mode in settings, and share the link or QR code. Launch takes 5–10 minutes.

items.q: Can I set automatic or manual booking confirmation?
items.a: Yes, the mode is chosen in settings. With automatic confirmation the guest is confirmed right after submitting the form. With manual, the request appears in the panel as "pending confirmation" — a manager confirms or declines it. Manual mode is handy when tables are limited.

items.q: Do you charge a fee per booking?
items.a: There are no fees: reservations are included in the subscription — no percentage from guests, no per-slot charges, no middlemen. A fixed payment and unlimited bookings.
